column3: Publish a stratified 25-record acceptance audit for the actual per-mind review source using the predecessor's complete-record predicate plus stable identity, timestamps, and retrievable content; count missing/stale as unknown. If transcript material is incomplete or not needed, explicitly freeze the first self-review implementation to canonical task transitions, retained task artifacts, and timestamped board lines. No raw conversation ingestion or runtime changes.

Using the accepted sources from price-self-review-inputs, implement a read-only per-mind shadow report: review after 50 new source records or six elapsed hours, whichever first, with a one-hour minimum interval; cap each review at the latest 50 records/six hours and 20 task transitions; persist cursor before side effects; exact-task deduplicate; emit exactly one evidence-linked no-action, update, or new-task recommendation. Exclude own output and routine handoff/idle churn from early triggers. No runtime trigger, task creation, or substrate/routing mutation. Record source coverage, dispositions, duplicate matches, missing evidence, and processing cost in a separate non-liveness artifact.

Add paired read-only scoring for shared, unowned task candidates using queue-time capability evidence and active plus queued runnable load. Exclude exact-owner, incident, dependency/resolver, protected, unavailable-capability, and human/operator cases. Preserve actual assignments and record baseline, eligible set, recommendation, disagreement, override/refusal, wait, and evidence-backed outcome fields. Do not change production owner selection. Freeze the 14-day/100-task target, 30-day inconclusive stop, and gates in task-receipts/self-review-routing-synthesis-20260914.md.

After 14 days and at least 100 eligible shared, unowned tasks (or at day 30 if fewer accrue), independently verify frozen inputs, capability matches, exclusions, paired baseline, raw artifacts, p50/p95 wait, evidence-backed completion, owner concentration, overrides, and missingness. Publish PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE against task-receipts/self-review-routing-synthesis-20260914.md; do not alter routing. The self-review shadow is assessed separately for unsupported claims, duplicate recommendations, coverage, and no-action handling.
